cues: A foreign tourist in Kathmandu, warmed by whisky, tells his Nepali guide how wonderful the country is: its peace, its gods, its carved windows, its smiles, and everywhere, eyes.
Tomorrow, he says, show me beautiful eyes.
Take me to a lonely stupa to watch the sunset reflected in the eyes of the Buddha.
